messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend periods that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or an observed holiday that creates a three‑day break.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (Observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the observed holiday was Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, AB, BC, NB, PEI, SK) | Family Day was on Monday, creating a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday long weekend. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday was on Friday, giving a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday break. |
| **Apr 8–10** | Easter Monday (observed in some provinces) | Easter Monday was on Monday; in provinces that observe it, this created a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday, giving a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (Observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the observed holiday was Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |
| **Aug 5–7** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, BC, NB, PEI, SK) | Civic Holiday was on Monday, giving a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday, giving a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday, giving a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas was on Monday, giving a Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |

These are the official public holidays that produced long weekends in Canada for the year 2023. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in PEI, etc.) or additional observed days, let me know!
